searchText: Our eip-7688 branch is still on alpha.8. Need to merge alpha.11 into unstable before updating this branch. The first SSZ Engine API breakout call is today! Fri, Jun 26 | 13:00 UTC (<t:1782478800:F>) Agenda: <https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2132> Meeting Link: [Zoom](<https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/86111351882?pwd=k0fTLCL3yR6ebh5k0v6tTeVlbHEb9c.1>) Same with Lighthouse, we haven't merged alpha.11 quite yet <@412614104222531604> is there a way to add new config params from the kurtosis yaml scenario? I implemented the new params and we are a bit strict. ```The specified network configuration had missing or invalid values for constants MAX_SIGNED_BEACON_BLOCK_SIZE, MAX_SIGNED_EXECUTION_PAYLOAD_BID_SIZE, MAX_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECAR_SIZE, MAX_ATTESTER_SLASHING_SIZE, MAX_SIGNED_AGGREGATE_AND_PROOF_SIZE``` it's preset not config though mmm right let me check ok all good, sorry for the noise 🙂 The following discussions were taken during the call - Moving the fork into the header and out of the url - Moving from engine/v2/ down to engine/v1/ - having both json and ssz co-existing and gradually making it compulsory past a certain fork per say - clients can start shipping this as fast as they want with a flag - after the fork beyond which it becomes compulosry json-engine rpc is retired - /engine/vx/{fork}/payloads/witness would be the way to go for <https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/773> - progressive will not be used for now.when 7688 is sfi-ed,we can rework to make the design using progressives - no specific devnet for this,can be added to the glamsterdam devnets and the flags can be enabled unanswered questions/differed - <https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/793#issuecomment-4454204579> - <https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/793#discussion_r3435225563> would request the client teams who havnt reviewed <https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/793> to do so as it would be the single source of truth 🙂 thanks for organizing it the pleasure is mine 😉 7688 state upgrade 7688 teku alpha11 compatible image: `ethpandaops/teku:tbenr-progressive_ssz_gloas_testing` wanna call it teku:glamsterdam-devnet-7? Later yes we have ethpandaops/dora:glamsterdam-devnet-7 image 7688 is being included in devnet-7, btw. you'll need progressives if you want to run ssz-engine on that devnet with 200M gas deposit reqs https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4630#issuecomment-4377125436 thanks, have added it to the kurtosis does it need extra flags? I'm getting an error: > == SERVICE 'cl-4-teku-nethermind' LOGS =================================== > Unknown option: '--Xp2p-quic-port=9001' This is a <@412614104222531604> problem 🙂 https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/pull/1442 ok it works 🙂 just missing the alpha.11 updates from lighthouse / lodestar, and the prysm / grandine impls yeah this is kinda tricky as new branches have the new flag old ones have the old. Would be good if you guys did a bit of an overlap where the experimental and non experimental flag is both working. cc <@504202741933932544> re SSZ engine, if you want a more proper one, <@449019668296892420> has some ideas on syncing additional branches (right now not possible), monitoring sync progress vs unavailable states (right now indistinguishable) etc, and then there's also the 7807 thing that makes block_hash == hash_tree_root so that CL can do validations autonomously and no logner needs the EL to optimistically sync (i.e., the nimbus behaviour where we just load the nimbus-EL library into the cl and do kzg and block hash validation locally if the EL is under maintenance). and then there's also the time of check / time of use bug which makes exchangeCapabilities kinda meh, because there may be EL upgrades/downgrades between requests, or an EL multiplexer may choose a different EL as one goes under maintenance. we don't normally care about breaking experimental flags (and you don't normally rush into adding them in kurtosis 🙂 ) this has been a pretty rare circumstance imo thanks to <@808969530608451584> we got genesis tools updated for 7688 as well. can test by fetching latest kurtosis from here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4630#issuecomment-4377125436 then change `gloas_fork_epoch` to `0` in the kurtosis. right now, I can load it fine in nimbus, but the others seem to fail to load that genesis state - teku fails to load the 7688 genesis <@504202741933932544> (see screenshot, your exceptiosn are too long for discord) - lighthouse fails to load the 7688 genesis <@818245058541125662> (not sure if related to the alpha.11) > Jun 26 23:31:42.679 INFO Starting from known genesis state > Jun 26 23:31:42.684 CRIT Failed to start beacon node reason: "Built-in genesis state SSZ bytes are invalid: OffsetsAreDecreasing(0)" - lodestar fails to load the 7688 genesis <@534934855113506836> (not sure if related to the alpha.11) > Jun-26 23:31:40.791[] info: Loaded genesis state size=83.79 KB > ✖ Error: First offset must equal to fixedEnd 14405 != 14277 > at readVariableOffsets (file:///usr/app/node_modules/.pnpm/@chainsafe+ssz@1.6.0/node_modules/@chainsafe/ssz/src/type/progressiveContainer.ts:674:15) > at ProgressiveContainerType.getFieldRanges (file:///usr/app/node_modules/.pnpm/@chainsafe+ssz@1.6.0/node_modules/@chainsafe/ssz/src/type/progressiveContainer.ts:428:21) > at ProgressiveContainerType.tree_deserializeFromBytes (file:///usr/app/node_modules/.pnpm/@chainsafe+ssz@1.6.0/node_modules/@chainsafe/ssz/src/type/progressiveContainer.ts:298:30) > at ProgressiveContainerType.deserializeToViewDU (file:///usr/app/node_modules/.pnpm/@chainsafe+ssz@1.6.0/node_modules/@chainsafe/ssz/src/type/composite.ts:151:23) > at initBeaconState (file:///usr/app/packages/cli/src/cmds/beacon/initBeaconState.ts:315:76) > at Object.beaconHandler [as handler] (file:///usr/app/packages/cli/src/cmds/beacon/handler.ts:79:9)

excerpts.author: razorclients
excerpts.content:
The following discussions were taken during the call

- Moving the fork into the header and out of the url
- Moving from engine/v2/ down to engine/v1/
- having both json and ssz co-existing and gradually making it compulsory past a certain fork per say 
- clients can start shipping this as fast as they want with a flag 
- after the fork beyond which it becomes compulosry json-engine rpc is retired
- /engine/vx/{fork}/payloads/witness would be the way to go for <https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/773>
- progressive will not be used for now.when 7688 is sfi-ed,we can rework to make the design using progressives
- no specific devnet for this,can be added to the glamsterdam devnets and the flags can be enabled


unanswered questions/differed

- <https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/793#issuecomment-4454204579>
- <https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/793#discussion_r3435225563>


would request the client teams who havnt reviewed <https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/793> to do so as it would be the single source of truth 🙂

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content: re SSZ engine, if you want a more proper one, <@449019668296892420> has some ideas on syncing additional branches (right now not possible), monitoring sync progress vs unavailable states (right now indistinguishable) etc, and then there's also the 7807 thing that makes block_hash == hash_tree_root so that CL can do validations autonomously and no logner needs the EL to optimistically sync (i.e., the nimbus behaviour where we just load the nimbus-EL library into the cl and do kzg and block hash validation locally if the EL is under maintenance). and then there's also the time of check / time of use bug which makes exchangeCapabilities kinda meh, because there may be EL upgrades/downgrades between requests, or an EL multiplexer may choose a different EL as one goes under maintenance.

excerpts.author: tbenr
excerpts.content: we don't normally care about breaking experimental flags (and you don't normally rush into adding them in kurtosis 🙂 ) this has been a pretty rare circumstance imo
